job.value: Notice the timed-auction section in search results and open the event

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The 'Charizard Collector's Vault' banner with 'ROUND 2/6' and price tiles above the normal results reads as an auction section within the SERP.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The pink auction section stands out, but there's no 'See all' or button saying how to open the event.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: Price tiles predict opening a card, but nothing on the section header says it opens the Event page.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'ROUND 2/6' and 'round 3 opens right after' introduce staggered rounds with no explanation of what a round is.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Browsing asks for no decisions the person can't make.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Round detail is shown as a single line; the rest is behind the tap.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: An auction for the searched card fits a TCG searcher.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: 'Round 2 closing in 1:29 — round 3 opens right after' is a sentence to parse before the tiles make sense.
